messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] 8 nodes in infer-pool-usw reported NotReady within 60s, routing spike -> 3xx/5xx errors for /v1/generate. link: https://redwood.tools/incidents/3005 :rotating_light:
Alice (oncall): on it, paging. what's the customer impact? any errors from front?
Maria (support): Customers: 3 accounts reporting 500s and streaming timeouts. Support ticket IDs 2812, 2817, 2820. Latency SLOs breached for some requests.
Sam SRE: seeing kubelet restarts on nodes: infer-usw-node-03, -07, -09. kubelet log shows repeated "Watchdog: timeout - restarting" events and container runtime OOMs.
Jia (infra): inspecting dmesg, there's a cpu softlockup + GPU driver errors on node-03. possible driver panic -> GPU off the bus -> kubelet restart loop.
Tony (eng-runtime): if drivers panic, runtime returns CUDA failure and containers crash. fallback routing should catch this but routing lagged ~30s. we need immediate mitigation.
Alice (oncall): immediate mitigation plan: 1) cordon affected nodes 2) evict pods to fallback pool 3) scale up fallback GPUs 4) restart kubelet after driver reload. assigning tasks.
Sam SRE: I'll cordon/evict. running:
```
kubectl cordon infer-usw-node-03
kubectl drain infer-usw-node-03 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force
kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide | grep infer-usw-node-03
```
Sam SRE: eviction started, pods rescheduled to infer-fallback-usw. Pods with attached GPUs failing over to CPU-backed fallback if no GPU available.
Maria (support): confirming reduced 500s for ticket 2812, still some streaming client timeouts for long-lived connections. letting customers know we're mitigating.
Tony (eng-runtime): enabling prefix caching and temporarily reducing batch size to lower memory pressure on fallback nodes. pushing config change now.
Jia (infra): kernel logs (snippet) from infer-usw-node-03:
```
[   52.123456] NMI watchdog: BUG: soft lockup - CPU#1 stuck for 23s!
[   52.123789] Xid (PCIe) error: Multiple uncorrectable errors detected in GPU 0
[   52.124000] NVRM: GPU at 0000:81:00.0: GPU has fallen off the bus.
[   52.124500] kernel: nvme0n1: I/O error, dev nvme0n1, sector 123456
```
Alice (oncall): looks like driver panic + possible I/O. remove nodes from rotation until driver image validated. Sam, keep cordoned. Jia, can you push an emergency driver rollback/upgrade image?
Jia (infra): on it. building a node image with the previous stable NVIDIA driver and a systemd drop-in to increase kubelet watchdog timeout. planning to roll to node-03 then 07.
deploy-bot: rollout started for infra/node-image-3005 -> infer-usw-node-03 :rocket:
Sam SRE: reboot + driver rollback on node-03 completed. kubelet restarted cleanly. keeping cordoned for now, running health checks.
Tony (eng-runtime): routing set to avoid infer-pool-usw for 15m. increased replica count in infer-fallback-usw by +2 and raised autoscaler target.
Maria (support): customers 2812=green, 2817=intermittent fails, 2820=partial. sending updated ETA: 30m, advising retry/backoff.
Alice (oncall): next steps: soak test rescheduled pods, monitor kubelet restarts and driver logs, check cgroup and disk pressure. If stable for 20m, uncordon.
Sam SRE: adding runbook entry: observed pattern "kubelet-skip-cycle" when driver OOM -> watchdog restart. creating follow-up ticket to analyze kernel oops and NVMe errors.
Alice (oncall): thanks team. tagging infra and runtime for post-incident follow-up. :thumbsup:
Tony (eng-runtime): logging note: fallback route handled ~220 requests in last 15m, retries added for in-flight streaming. will correlate with tracing.
incident-bot: incident state -> acknowledged by Alice (oncall). severity -> Sev2. incident link: https://redwood.tools/incidents/3005
